title: Pick the composition
question: Three hyper-minimal takes on the AI review. Pick one to build; the schedule and other pages follow the same system.

options.label: Focus
options.thesis: No chrome. One centered column, big quiet title, one line per change plus its reason, keyboard first.
options.viewport: Centered review column, black Apply button, keyboard hints.

options.label: Side panel
options.thesis: Quiet sidebar and schedule; the review opens as a calm right panel so you see context while approving.
options.risk: Narrow panel gets tight on long reasons.

options.label: Diff review
options.thesis: A code-review style page: bordered rows, red and green inline diffs, missing showtimes in their own section.
options.viewport: Breadcrumb top bar, summary box, diff rows, sticky footer.
options.risk: Red/green carries meaning, needs a text cue too.
